title: Floor
description: The carpeted floor has long since given up trying to look clean.
details:
Between the desk and the couch lies the usual geography of your place: tangled wires, cassette cases, loose notes, computer magazines, and things you were definitely going to organize someday.

In the glow of the monitor and the orange lamps, the mess stops looking accidental and starts looking inhabited. Like evidence of a life continuously happening slightly faster than it can be cleaned up.
takeFailure: You cannot take it with you. Besides it is very big.
